prompt: Copper paints the fence bright yellow
title: Bright Yellow Fence
irony: Copper paints the fence yellow for next year's buyers, but its brightness makes today so fun that nobody wants to leave.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Copper stands by his old grey fence on the quiet night street as Green and Jade gather with paint cans.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants a neat yellow stripe and recites paint facts while Copper, late with brushes, talks about next year's buyers.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lilac arrives with her rule book and says street fences must stay grey, so the yellow plan must stop.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The gang sings the bright-yellow-fence hook together while brushes wave and paint glows in the lamplight.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Copper fetches the wrong yellow, Green over-measures and freezes, and Jade splashes paint across the path.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Jade dares a big swoosh, the brush slips, and Copper's nose, Green's book, and the lamp post turn yellow.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The gang sings the bright-yellow-fence hook again while yellow drops dot the grey fence in the lamplight.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Copper looks at the half-yellow fence and sings quietly about chasing next year and missing today.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Copper decides today on the street beats next year and invites everyone to paint together now.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Copper sings the turned line about today beating tomorrow while the gang finishes the fence bright yellow together.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The gang sings the hook by the glowing yellow fence as neighbours stop to stay and Lilac closes her rule book.
